target_beneficiaries: Pre-Matric, Post-Matric, Top-Class, and Merit-cum-Means students from minority, SC, ST, OBC, and EWS backgrounds.

application_steps.portal_action: Generate unique 14-digit OTR number via Aadhaar / Face Auth on NSP OTR App
Log in with OTR and fill application form

input_fields.name: scholarship_category
options: Post-Matric / Top-Class / MCM (Class 11, 12, UG, PG, Ph.D.)

input_fields.name: institution_name
input_fields.description: Must have valid AISHE / UDISE code

application_steps.portal_action: System dynamically presents eligible central/state schemes based on student profile
documents_to_upload: Bonafide Student Certificate signed by School Principal / Dean
Fee receipt of current academic course
Bank Passbook copy (Account must be in student's name & Aadhaar-seeded)

workflow: L1 Verification: Institute Nodal Officer (INO) verifies student bonafide & fee details
L2 Verification: District Nodal Officer (DNO) / State Nodal Officer (SNO) verifies income and caste genuineness
PFMS Merit List Generation & Direct Benefit Transfer to bank account
